blocks.text: Organizations ko yaqeeni banana hota hai ke un ka cloud services ka istemal legal (qanooni) aur regulatory requirements (sarkari rules ki shartein) ke mutabiq ho. Yeh requirements ilaqe (region) aur industry ke hisaab se badal sakte hain.

items: Compliance (laws aur rules maanna): organizations ko data privacy, security aur apni industry ke khaas standards se related rules maanne hote hain. Cloud providers aksar aise tools aur features dete hain jo in requirements ko poora karne mein madad karte hain.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Cloud computing IT infrastructure ka kharcha bohat kam kar sakti hai, kyunke organizations mehnge hardware aur us ki maintenance par paisa lagane ki bajaye sirf un resources ki qeemat dete hain jo woh istemal karte hain.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Un cloud-based services ki list banayein jo aap istemal karte hain ya jaante hain. Har service ke liye likhein ke woh aap ko ya aap ke organization ko kya faida deti hai, aur apne data ki hifazat ke liye aap kaun si security measures istemal karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Hospital ko yeh parwah kyun ho sakti hai ke us ka cloud data kahan rakha gaya hai?
blocks.explanation: Mareezon ka data sensitive (naazuk, jise chhupa kar rakhna zaroori ho) hai; privacy ke laws us ki hifazat zaroori banate hain aur kuch jagahon par yeh bhi ke data kahan rakha jaye. Is liye hospital ko aisa provider aur settings chunni hoti hain jo in laws ke mutabiq hon.

blocks.prompt: Class Activity ka namuna: apni cloud services, un ka faida aur hifazat ka tareeqa.
blocks.explanation: Maslan: Gmail (email; mazboot password aur two-step verification se mehfooz) aur Google Drive (school ki files kahin se bhi; sirf chune hue logon ke saath share). Har student apni services, faida aur security measures khud likhe.

items: Compliance: data privacy, security aur industry standards ke rules maanna.
Rules ilaqe aur industry ke hisaab se badalte hain; providers madadgar tools dete hain.
